audience: online shop owners and their staff who run orders, stock and discount codes in Imker SalesCRM

useCases.title: Find sold-out and active products
useCases.text: List the products with their stock fields and active state. Open one product to read its full description and category ids.

useCases.title: Find unpaid orders from this week
useCases.text: List the orders placed in a date range that have no payment yet. Open one order to read its items, addresses and costs.

useCases.title: Review order count and sales by period
useCases.text: Get the number and total sum of orders for a date range, grouped by day, week or month. Canceled and returned orders are left out.

useCases.title: Create a discount code for a campaign
useCases.text: Check the existing discount codes, then create a new one with its value, limits and validity dates. It goes live at once, or on the start date you set.

useCases.title: Change the validity of a discount code
useCases.text: Read one discount code with all its rules. Update only the fields you send, such as the end date, and keep the other rules as they are.
